result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban canyon with multi-lane traffic and high-rise commercial buildings. While sidewalks are in good condition, the lack of marked crosswalks and the significant unprotected crossing distance pose risks to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to traverse multiple lanes without any mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main street.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Markings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at the intersection reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian crossings.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install bold, continental-style markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a well-developed urban intersection with wide sidewalks, a textured crosswalk, and signalized pedestrian crossings. The environment is dominated by commercial and institutional buildings, including a theater and a parking garage, which introduces multiple vehicle-pedestrian conflict points.

hazards.name: Turning vehicle conflicts
hazards.description: Vehicles turning from the main road onto the side street may conflict with pedestrians in the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Parking garage access
hazards.description: The entrance to the parking garage on the left creates a conflict point where vehicles cross the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds at the intersection.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Provide pedestrians with a head start before vehicles receive a green light to reduce conflicts with turning traffic.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow traffic and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban multi-lane street with high-rise commercial and residential buildings. While sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median or refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
